function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

message.content:
Shashi Tej Reddy is a former Indian Army officer who entered politics in the early 2010s.  
He served in the army for more than two decades, rising to the rank of colonel and commanding a regiment in the Eastern Command. After retiring, he joined the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and contested the Lok Sabha elections from the Nandyal constituency in Andhra Pradesh.  

* In the 2014 general election he ran as the BJP candidate from Nandyal but lost to Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy of the YSR Congress Party.  
* He again contested the 2019 general election from the same seat, again finishing second to Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy.  

Beyond electoral politics, Reddy has been involved in defense‑related business ventures and has served on the boards of several defense‑industry companies. He is known for his emphasis on national security issues and for advocating stronger defense procurement policies.
